topic: Copy text from a photo of a page
hook: Your phone can copy the words off a printed page.
title: Your Phone Can Copy Text Off a Paper Page
description:
Open the Google app on any Android or iPhone, tap the Lens icon and point it at a book. The words become text you can copy and paste. Try it now with whatever is near you.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #GoogleLens
comment_prompt: Did it work on your phone? Yes or no
